description: This file manages event handling, including subscribing, unsubscribing, and publishing events related to vaults, notes, sheets, and toasts within the Notesnook project. It defines types, utility functions, and a ToastManager for user notifications.

classes.name: Vault
classes.description: Type defining the structure and properties of a vault object, including access controls and event handling for unlocking.

classes.name: NoteEdit
classes.description: Type representing the editing state of a note, including its ID and editing flags.

classes.name: SheetAction
classes.description: Type for actions that can be presented in a sheet, including the action callback and display properties.

classes.name: PresentSheetOptions
classes.description: Type for options used to present a sheet, including UI components, actions, and callbacks.

classes.name: ToastOptions
classes.description: Type for configuration options for toast notifications.

methods.name: eSubscribeEvent
methods.description: Subscribes to a specific event with a provided handler.

methods.name: eUnSubscribeEvent
methods.description: Unsubscribes a handler from a specific event.

methods.name: eSendEvent
methods.description: Publishes an event with optional arguments.

methods.name: openVault
methods.description: Triggers the event to open a vault dialog with provided data.

methods.name: sendNoteEditedEvent
methods.description: Sends an event indicating a note has been edited.

methods.name: presentSheet
methods.description: Publishes an event to open a sheet with specified options.

methods.name: hideSheet
methods.description: Publishes an event to close the currently open sheet.
